entry_only: decision_frame_rejection on the broker fill path
existing_position_state: direction must be BUY or SELL
units must be finite and non-zero before a close is sent
management_pricing: instrument identity, finite positive bid/ask, and non-inverted bid/ask are checked first
no M5 close fallback for broker management
paper management still uses the decision close only when that frame exists
new_exposure_authorisation: PositionClose does not require a candle seal or an entry-quote seal
a protective close does not change live-order authorisation
protective_close: PositionClose longUnits for BUY and shortUnits for SELL
weekend flatten is time-triggered and does not need a decision candle
a missing management quote does not block a broker PositionClose
paper or mid closes without a price are not marked successful
close exceptions do not call close_position and are not retried
symbol_cycle: run_bot refreshes the pricing snapshot once
_load_decision_candles fetches M5 candles inside a contained helper
get_position runs even when the decision frame is missing
existing positions enter the management branch before any new-entry gate
new entries require a usable frame and then the existing provenance, risk, and authorisation gates
